title: AZ Alkmaar Faces Willem II in Match That Could Define League Lead
seoTitle: AZ Alkmaar vs Willem II: Eredivisie League Decider
subtitle: Match scheduled for September 11 brings together the unbeaten leader with the team fighting to escape the relegation zone
excerpt: Eredivisie leaders AZ Alkmaar, with five consecutive wins, host Willem II, who are desperate for points to escape the relegation zone in a crucial clash.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between AZ Alkmaar and Willem II, scheduled for September 11, stands out as it brings together the Eredivisie's unbeaten leader with the club trying to escape the relegation zone. The match could extend AZ's lead in the title race or offer Willem II crucial relief in their fight for survival.

AZ Alkmaar Aims to Extend Unbeaten Run

AZ approaches the game with five wins in five matches, accumulating 18 points. The team has scored 16 goals and conceded only five, keeping two clean sheets. Their average possession is 57%, with a pass accuracy of 85.95%.

Willem II Tries to Escape the Danger Zone

Willem II occupies 16th position, with one point from four games. The club has scored 13 goals and has an average possession of 41%, with a pass accuracy of 75.53%. The team has not won since their promotion to the top flight.

Absences That Could Influence the Result

AZ is without Hobie Verhulst, Denso Kasius, and Kees Smit due to injury. Willem II has several absences, including goalkeeper Thomas Didillon, defender Justin Hoogma, midfielders Vito van Crooy, Jari Schuurman, and Amine Lachkar, and forwards Armin Culum and Anass Zarrouk.

Top Scorers and Playmakers

Ro Daal leads the Eredivisie scoring charts with four goals, while Mateo Chávez has three assists. For Willem II, Devin Haen has already scored twice, and Nathan Tjoe-A-On has two assists, indicating that quick service to Haen could be the visitors' main weapon.

What's at Stake for Each Team

An AZ victory would take the club to 18 points, further strengthening their title bid. For Willem II, any positive point could ease the pressure and bring them closer to safety, providing room to recover lost ground in the relegation zone.
